proposal.hypothesis: A CTA can cooperatively load each 256-source tile's x, y, z, and mass once into shared memory, letting the existing one-thread-per-target mapping reuse those values across target threads. This may reduce repeated global source loads, though barriers and shared-memory traffic may offset the benefit, especially at small sizes.

retained: Load source x, y, z, and mass in CTA-sized shared-memory tiles and reuse each tile for all active targets in the block.
Keep every lane in the shared-tile loop and execute both block barriers even when the target index is out of range.
Preserve the original target index formula, self-interaction skip, force calculation, integration order, and copied particle mass.
